app.name: Slack
app.tier_reason: users.list has no activity field; the last sign-in per user comes from the separate team.accessLogs endpoint (paid plans)

auth.role_required: Workspace Owner or Admin (team.accessLogs needs a user token with the admin scope)
setup_steps: api.slack.com/apps > Create New App > From scratch, in your workspace
OAuth & Permissions > User Token Scopes: add users:read, users:read.email and admin
Install to Workspace as an Owner or Admin, then copy the User OAuth Token (starts with xoxp-)

rate_limit.plan_note: users.list and team.accessLogs are both Tier 2 (20+ per minute)

field_map.name: profile.real_name
field_map.role: is_primary_owner && 'Primary owner' || is_owner && 'Owner' || is_admin && 'Admin' || is_ultra_restricted && 'Single-channel guest' || is_restricted && 'Multi-channel guest' || 'Member'

warnings: Slack answers errors with HTTP 200 and ok: false (for example paid_only on a free workspace, or missing_scope); the connector then finds no records
team.accessLogs is for paid workspaces only and needs a user token with the admin scope; a bot token can't call it
users.list includes deactivated people (deleted: true) and guests; Slackbot is listed with is_bot false, so it is dropped by its ID
Single-channel guests are free; multi-channel guests are billed like members
Slack's Fair Billing Policy already credits members inactive for more than 28 days; count that before estimating savings
